snippets.output: Singulair, also known as montelukast, is an oral tablet and not an inhaler.
Singulair (montelukast) is commonly used for the management of asthma and allergic rhinitis.
Montelukast works by blocking leukotrienes, which are chemicals in the body that cause inflammation, bronchoconstriction, and mucus production.
